theme: Handoff day — the girls are back with you.
greeting: A clear calendar and a big handoff, Dan: the four girls come at 3 and the family stretch with you and Mike begins. The one knot to untangle tonight is Claire's St Pete appointment landing tomorrow morning against the Orlando plan.

needsAttention.title: Claire's St Pete appointment
needsAttention.detail: Claire has a 10:20 AM appointment in St Pete tomorrow, but the family is booked at the Orlando villa through the 27th. Worth reconciling tonight whether that means a drive back in the morning or a reschedule.

needsAttention.title: Grocery run before the villa
needsAttention.detail: The Royal Palms villa has a kitchen. Slot a store stop near St Pete or Orlando into today's drive after the 3 PM pickup so five nights with six people don't default to eating out.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Book it refundable now while inventory holds — the Pathfinder is south until late May.

flagged.title: PRISM directors summit
flagged.detail: The LGBTQ corporate-directors network rebranded to PRISM and opened registration for its NYC annual summit — a board-network fit worth a look.

flagged.title: Coke Bottle House invite
flagged.detail: You and Mike are invited to Marie's birthday on Vinalhaven, Saturday Oct 3 at 5 PM, if you're still on the island.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail promos — Foreign Affairs, NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, JetBlue, Expedia, Monocle, Adobe and the like.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply from you.

resolved.title: Disney weekend confirmed
resolved.detail: Walt Disney World's vacation confirmation came through this morning (order #CXKE94323232) — the Sept 26–27 park weekend is set.

recipe.title: Braised Pheasant with Mushrooms and Bacon
recipe.why: An autumn braise for cooler evenings, when game and mushrooms are at their peak.

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the St Pete morning is yours before the day turns to logistics.
The four girls get picked up at 3, and the custody stretch with you and Mike begins.
Settle the girls in for the first night; the Orlando villa and Disney weekend are booked from here.
